грамматика.def: A system of rules and principles for the structure of a language, or of languages in general.

морфология.def: The study of the internal structure of morphemes (words and their semantic building blocks).

синтаксис.def: The study of the structure of phrases, sentences, and language.

орфография.def: A method of representing a language or the sounds of language by written symbols.

пунктуация.def: A set of symbols and marks which are used to clarify meaning in text by separating strings of words into clauses, phrases and sentences.

лексика.def: The set of all words and phrases in a language; any unified subset of words from a particular language.

ударение.def: The relative emphasis or prominence given to a certain syllable in a word or to a certain word in a phrase or sentence.

часть речи.def: A linguistic category of words sharing syntactic or morphological behaviour and semantic properties, such as noun or verb.

имя существительное.def: A word that functions as the name of a specific object or set of objects, such as person, animal, place, word, thing, phenomenon, substance, quality, or idea.

имя прилагательное.def: A word that modifies a noun or noun phrase or describes a noun’s referent.

глагол.def: A word that indicates an action, event, or state of being.

наречие.def: A word that modifies a verb, adjective, other adverbs, or various other types of words, phrases, or clauses.

местоимение.def: A word or a group of words that one may substitute for a noun or noun phrase.

имя числительное.def: A number word, a simple or compound word for a number often having particular grammatical attributes depending on the language.

предлог.def: Any of a class of non-inflecting words and multiword terms typically employed to connect a following noun or a pronoun, in an adjectival or adverbial sense, with some other word.

союз.def: A word used to join other words, phrases, or clauses together into sentences.

частица.def: A part of speech that has no inherent lexical definition but must be associated with another word to impart meaning, often a grammatical category.

междометие.def: A phrase or word with no particular grammatical relation to a sentence but which serves to express emotion or as a filled pause.

причастие.def: A form of a verb that may function as an adjective, noun or adverb.

деепричастие.def: A participle that modifies a verb in the same sentence and is equivalent to an adverbial clause in English.

падеж.def: A specific inflection of a word (particularly a noun, pronoun, or adjective) depending on its function in the sentence.

именительный падеж.def: The case used to indicate the subject—or agent—of a finite verb.

родительный падеж.def: The grammatical case, chiefly applicable to nouns, used to express a relationship of origin or possession.

дательный падеж.def: Case used to express direction towards an indirect object, the recipient or beneficiary of an action.

винительный падеж.def: The case used to mark the immediate object (direct object) on which the transitive verb acts.

творительный падеж.def: A noun case used to express means or agency.

предложный падеж.def: A noun case serving as object of a preposition.

склонение.def: A way of categorizing nouns, pronouns, or adjectives according to the inflections they receive.

род.def: A division of nouns and pronouns (and sometimes of other parts of speech) into masculine or feminine, and sometimes other categories like neuter or common, and animate or inanimate.

мужской род.def: Of, pertaining or belonging to the male grammatical gender, in languages that have gender distinctions.

женский род.def: Of, pertaining or belonging to the female grammatical gender, in languages that have gender distinctions.

средний род.def: Having a form which is not masculine nor feminine.

число.def: Of a word or phrase, the state of being singular, dual or plural, shown by inflection.

единственное число.def: A form of a word that refers to only one person or thing.

множественное число.def: A word in the form in which it potentially refers to something other than one person or thing.

одушевлённость.def: The characteristic of a noun, dependent on its living or sentient nature, which affects grammatical features.

окончание.def: The last morpheme of a word, added to some base to make an inflected form (such as -s in "dogs").

основа.def: The main part of an uninflected word to which affixes may be added to form inflections of the word.

корень.def: The primary lexical unit of a word, which carries the most significant aspects of semantic content and cannot be reduced into smaller constituents.

приставка.def: A morpheme added to the beginning of a word to modify its meaning.

суффикс.def: A morpheme added at the end of a word to modify the word's meaning.

вид.def: A grammatical category that expresses how a verbal action, event, or state, extends over time.

совершенный вид.def: A grammatical aspect that describes an action viewed as a simple whole.

несовершенный вид.def: A grammatical aspect used for ongoing, habitual, repeated, or similar semantic roles, whether they are in the past, present, or future.

время.def: The property of indicating the point in time at which an action or state of being occurs or exists.

настоящее время.def: A grammatical tense whose principal function is to locate a situation or event in the present time.

прошедшее время.def: A grammatical tense whose function is to place an action or situation in the past.

будущее время.def: The tense or time form of a verb used to refer to an event or occurrence that has not yet happened or is expected to happen in the future.

лицо.def: A linguistic category used to distinguish between the speaker of an utterance and those to whom or about whom they are speaking.

наклонение.def: A verb form that depends on how its containing clause relates to the speaker’s or writer’s wish, intent, or assertion about reality.

изъявительное наклонение.def: The mood of a verb used in ordinary, factual, or objective statements.

повелительное наклонение.def: The grammatical mood generally expressing a command, though also used to express a request or permission.

сослагательное наклонение.def: Mood expressing an action or state which is hypothetical or anticipated rather than actual, including wishes and commands.

залог.def: A particular way of inflecting or conjugating verbs, or a particular form of a verb, which indicates the relation of the subject of the verb to the action which the verb expresses.

действительный залог.def: The form in which the subject of a verb carries out some action.

страдательный залог.def: The form of a transitive verb in which its subject receives the action.

спряжение.def: The act or process of conjugating a verb.

инфинитив.def: A non-finite verb form considered neutral with respect to inflection; depending on language variously found used with auxiliary verbs, in subordinate clauses, or acting as a gerund, and often as the dictionary form.

возвратный глагол.def: A verb whose subject and direct object are the same.

переходный глагол.def: A verb that is accompanied (either clearly or implicitly) by a direct object in the active voice.

степень сравнения.def: A form of an adjective that indicates a different degree of the attribute the adjective denotes; like the positive, comparative and superlative forms.

сравнительная степень.def: The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing two entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something.

превосходная степень.def: The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing three or more entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something.

краткая форма.def: Particularly in Slavic languages, a shortened form of the adjective, used predicatively.

предложение.def: A grammatically complete series of words consisting of a subject and predicate, even if one or the other is implied.

словосочетание.def: A word or, more commonly, a group of words that functions as a single unit in the syntax of a sentence.

подлежащее.def: The noun, pronoun or noun phrase about whom the statement is made.

сказуемое.def: The part of the sentence (or clause) which states a property that a subject has or is characterized by.

дополнение.def: The noun phrase which is an internal complement of a verb phrase or a prepositional phrase. In a verb phrase with a transitive action verb, it is typically the receiver of the action.

определение.def: A word that qualifies a noun.

обстоятельство.def: A word or a group of words that modifies or more closely defines the sentence or the verb.

гласный.def: A sound produced by the vocal cords with relatively little restriction of the oral cavity, forming the prominent sound of a syllable.

согласный.def: A sound that results from the passage of air through restrictions of the oral cavity.

слог.def: A unit of human speech which often forms words corresponding to one opening of the mouth; a vowel and its surrounding consonants.

алфавит.def: The set of letters used when writing in a language.

твёрдый знак.def: The Cyrillic letter Ъ/ъ, which in modern languages serves to denote a hard (non-palatalized) consonant.

мягкий знак.def: The Cyrillic letter Ь/ь, which in modern languages using the Cyrillic alphabet serves to denote a soft (palatized) consonant.
